reference_evidence.native_tuple_equivalence: OPEN until actually established per component; CommonFamily stored interval inputs differ from reference point-input scope.

tasks.title: Source C2 domain and branch predicate
implementation: Prove exact rational endpoint conversion and actual frozen gas chart; compute monotone T/p/simplex margins on X and a surrounding open witness.

Use stored nHe/nH and the paired blanket whose endpoints are binary64 source-ordered FHE*(1-8*EPSILON) and FHE*(1+8*EPSILON); audit all D and physical incoming positivity, fixed energy cutoffs, hat/guard branches and min/max/nonneg semantics.
Separate underlying source-real C2 from rounded program/interval endpoint operations; preserve signed derivatives at zero stock and thermal-w coordinate meaning.
acceptance: Whole X times whole Theta and an open real-formula extension are evidenced by actual leaves and source paths, not a boolean label.
HH temperature gate remains enforced when lambda=0; physical guard failure remains an explicit failure.
Stored interval inputs, coefficient uncertainty and reference point family are distinguished; no silent reference-to-native promotion.

tasks.title: Whole-source export into existing uniform adapter
implementation: Execute only the two named stage first targets: two direct residual calls per stage for whole X and gas-center, both over whole Theta.
Export Gc,A,G_lambda,G_b,G_lambdab,G_g_lambda,G_g_b,G_gg and full signed Jets with actual PreBE/source/carry identity.

acceptance: Whole-source data originates from the actual private producer flow; imported JSON/labels cannot create native authority.
Jnorm, rounded heat-leaf Psi and coordinate transforms remain exact to the declared leaf graph.
B,beta,q,radius,strict margins and all unresolved source/C2 premises are saved; no native root/U/V/W/I is produced.

tasks.title: Native-leaf HH-photo source directional witness
implementation: Reuse captured q/sigma/heat/source/denominator Jets to form H_g P_M and (P_M)_g H and independently evaluate the closed source directional formulas.
Use actual M=dN/db amount or explicitly B_dt=M/dt; preserve one factor of dt in G_b=-dt*P_M.
Check native support and a*p<w, source G_lambdab identity versus interval inclusion, and energy projection with E+epsilon.
acceptance: Witness is labeled source-directional; it is not actual implicit W, finite I, or full/two-half defect.
Native/reference leaf equality, interval inclusion, overlap and mismatches are reported separately.
No extra source/HH/provider callback, finite-difference, corner/root sampling, reference rerun or old target replay.

tasks.title: Independent scoped decision, complete return and dual delivery

Preserve original command/logs/exit/resource/source/build/test-binary identity and post-test changes; do not fabricate final-test coverage.

Every unmeasured value remains null and every unexecuted gate is named; native authority remains null/false.
START and handoff/tasks/return/receipt are included in backups for attachment-free continuation; upload metadata and actual restore are distinct.
